kind: Static measurement of retail jk2mp.exe and vm/jk2mpgame.qvm, plus developer-server bot runs against the retail QVM
installation: legitimate retail Jedi Outcast 1.02a, read and never written
sourceAvailability: Raven released no multiplayer source for this title; every number read out of the retail binaries
claims: shape of two records, the offset of one field, a count of which imports exist; no packet encoded, no entity converted, no gameplay, rendering or wire claim

deltaTable.coverage: every four-byte slot from 4 to 292 with no gap

entityState.typing: zero bits means float (trBase, trDelta, both angle vectors, both origins, speed); 1 to 32 bits means integer
entityState.heldBy: tests/jk2_abi_layout_tests.cpp (every offset, width and kind at compile time)

linked.reading: mov [esi+0x128], 1 on link, zeroed on unlink

placedNotEvidenced.basis: offsets not in doubt (only free slots); which member sits where is read from Quake III's order
placedNotEvidenced.headerMarking: each line marked evidenced or placed

ping.evidence: the one place the engine writes it: jk2mp.exe ping pass stores ps->ping = cl->ping at [eax + 0x1e4]
ping.notInDeltaTable: no engine in this line delta-codes a ping

arrays.unnamedHandling: declared as unnamed spans; the reader does not carry them; deliberately no way to write one

gameImports.method: negative constants called by the QVM (system call number is -1 - address); argument count is the widest OP_ARG offset written before the call

comparisonWithJka.elementaryActionBlock400to425: agrees on every one of the 16 both call
comparisonWithJka.block0: does not agree; G_CVAR_REGISTER is four arguments in Academy and two in Outcast, G_FS_FCLOSE_FILE one and five
comparisonWithJka.ghoul2Block584Up: 587 matches at nine arguments; 589, 590, 591, 595 and 596 differ
comparisonWithJka.caveat: agreeing argument counts are evidence for a correspondence, not proof; no import is served on that strength alone

23.meaning: a brush model, by entity and name

passEntityMinusOne.fnTech3Reading: no pass entity, said deliberately rather than reproducing an out-of-bounds read

run200.matches: Quake III's setup, shutdown, snapshot entity, console message and user command argument counts

run500.argumentCountAgreementWithQvm: twelve handlers; eleven for eleven that the bytecode writes
run500.imports586and587: share one routine, nine arguments with five pointers, the shape of Academy's two bolt-position calls at 587 and 589; recorded and not served

walks the instance's models, true at the first not removed
bounds-checks the model index, hands a name to a lookup over two lists
bounds-checks the same way, stores one int inside the model
reach the bot-library export table at 0xb0d230
